text:
incident-bot: :warning: Canary anomaly detected for rollout v2.14 on route=/generate. Trigger: canary 5xx rate 4.1% (threshold 0.5%), p95 latency jumped 2.1s -> 4.0s in 4m window. Canary traffic: 12%. Paging eng-sre oncall.

sara (oncall): i'm on it. can someone paste the rollout and flag details?

deploy-bot: v2.14 deployed to canary (group: canary) at 2026-03-15T09:12Z by james. Active feature flags: feat-kv-cache-v2=true, runtime=quant-4bit. Rollout: https://deploy.redwood.internal/rollouts/279

alex: pulling canary logs. seeing repeated upstream 502s and gateway timeouts 504. proxies show connection resets for a subset of connections. tails show large spike in proxy CPU around the errors.

mike: checking node infra metrics. GPU memory looks fine, but the proxy sidecar CPU and socket backlog for a few pods are high. no OOMs.

james: we flipped on new kv eviction heuristics + quantized runtime for v2.14. ran perf tests but maybe not this traffic pattern.

sara (oncall): plan: 1) flip kill-switch for feat-kv-cache-v2 in canary 2) if errors persist, roll canary back to v2.13 3) block global rollout. i'll toggle the flag now.

sara (oncall): @deploy-bot toggle-flag feat-kv-cache-v2 scope=canary state=off

deploy-bot: Flag toggle executed. feat-kv-cache-v2=OFF for canary. change id cf-9935. Expected propagation ~45s.

alex: watching logs; beginning to see fewer 502 spikes on some pods.

mike: socket backlogs decreased on replaced pods, but overall 5xx still at ~1.2% (baseline 0.3%).

sara (oncall): since kill-switch improved but not fully resolved, prepping manual rollback for canary to v2.13. executing rollback now.

sara (oncall): command:
```
# rollback canary group to previous stable
deployctl rollback --service inference --to-version v2.13 --scope canary --reason "canary regression: 5xx/latency" --force
```

deploy-bot: Rollback started (rb-5601). Replacing canary pods with v2.13 replicas. ETA ~3m.

alex: replacing pods come up and pass readiness. health checks OK. old pods terminating.

mike: infra metrics: connection resets drop, proxy CPU returns to normal on new pods.

deploy-bot: Rollback rb-5601 complete. state=SUCCESS. Link: https://deploy.redwood.internal/rollbacks/rb-5601

sara (oncall): verification checklist: - run smoke generates - check p95 and 5xx for canary - validate any recent customer errors - ensure alerts suppressed to avoid noise during verification

alex: smoke test sample prompt -> 410ms. service-level traces show no new 502s on rolled-back pods.

sara (oncall): metrics now: canary p95 0.52s, 5xx 0.18%. returning to baseline.

tanya: we received a customer report (zendesk 9012) about intermittent failures in summarize endpoint. reached out, they provided repro. I'll keep them posted; marking mitigated for now.

lina (pm): global rollout is paused automatically after canary failure, right?

james: yes, rollout paused. i'll open a follow-up: suspected regression in kv-cache eviction with quantized runtime handling long sequences. i'll create a reproducer and block re-rollout until fix and extra long-token canary tests pass.

sara (oncall): severity: Sev2 (customer-facing but limited impact). creating incident entry and assigning RCA owners. handing off follow-up to alex for logs/repro, james for code fix, mike for infra checks.

alex: taking follow-up for next 4h. i'll collect core dumps and run targeted synthetic canary with prompts >2048 tokens locally.

sara (oncall): muting alert rule 'canary-5xx-alert' for 2h to suppress noise while we validate.

deploy-bot: Alert rule muted (mute id m-7751) by sara for 2h.

sara (oncall): incident note: 2026-03-15T09:12Z canary v2.14 introduced errors and latency on /generate. feature-flag kill-switch partially helped; manual rollback to v2.13 completed at ~2026-03-15T09:26Z. Impact: small set of beta customers saw intermittent failures (zendesk 9012). Actions: pause rollout, add long-sequence canary tests, reproduce and patch kv-cache + quant path, schedule patch rollout after validation. Incident id INC-2026-0315-02.

lina (pm): thanks. timeline target for RCA: 48h. assign owners: james (serving), alex (repro), mike (infra), tanya (customer comms).

james: acknowledged. i'll branch a fix and run internal canary with the new test harness.

tanya: i'll follow up with the tenant and update ticket status to 'mitigated; monitoring'.

sara (oncall): handing off to alex. if anything spikes call me.

alex: taking it. will update thread with repro artifacts and next steps.

sara (oncall): :white_check_mark: initial mitigation complete; moving to RCA work.

end of thread.
